metadata.title: Aster reading and buffer data model

purpose.content: The data model defines what a Reading means, who owns it, and how the bounded buffer preserves value meaning without describing request sequencing.

fields.design_subject: Reading values, their fields and invariants, buffer ownership, and retention meaning.
fields.requirements_links: UTC timestamps, finite Celsius values, latest-valid retention, and immutable history requirements drive the model.

entities.content: Reading is a value object with sensorId, utcTimestamp, celsius, and quality; Sensor identity is stable across all readings.

fields.entities: Reading is the only entity; Sensor is an identified source, and RingBuffer is an owner of retained Reading values.
fields.fields: sensorId is nonempty text, utcTimestamp is UTC ISO 8601, celsius is finite, and quality is valid, suspect, or missing.

relationships.content:
Every Reading has exactly one Sensor source and at most one retaining hub buffer. The table separates provenance, retained cardinality and export ownership; export copies values without mutable aliases.

| Relationship | Cardinality | Ownership rule |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Sensor → Reading | 1 → 0..many; each Reading has one source | Stable sensor identity records provenance |
| RingBuffer → Reading | 1 → 0..10; each retained value has at most one buffer | Hub owns values; buffer owns FIFO retention order |
| Exporter → Reading | Copies of returned values | Immutable value copies; no mutable shared reference |
| Reading → ForecastRecord | None | No ownership or semantic equivalence |

fields.relationships: Sensor 1→many Reading and RingBuffer 1→0..10 Reading; no relationship exists between Reading and ForecastRecord.
fields.ownership: AsterHub owns values after validation, buffer owns retention order, and exporter receives immutable copies.
fields.diagram_decisions: [{"concern":"data-relationships","applies":true,"choice":"table","rationale":"Two cardinalities and one ownership rule are clearer in a schema table.","asset":null,"model_view":null}]

invariants.content: Timestamps never move backward within one sensor, values must be finite, and buffer eviction removes only the oldest valid entry.

fields.invariants: Finite celsius, UTC timestamps, stable sensorId, nondecreasing time, immutable exported values, and FIFO eviction are mandatory.
fields.lifecycle: A Reading is created by validation, retained up to eviction, copied for export, and never edited in place.

projection.content: The projection uses an immutable Reading record and a small invariant suite for finite values, time order, cardinality, and copy-on-export behavior.

fields.source_projection: Reading, ReadingQuality, and RingBuffer are intended data types; no ORM or database schema is implied.
fields.verification_links: Field validation, timestamp ordering, cardinality, immutability, and FIFO cases are planned checks.
